subject: Re: Kickoff: AssembleNet / AssembleNet++ for video understanding
body:
Lucia,

Staffing: Yusuf leads at 60%, Paloma 50% on the TF1 environment and data pipeline. Nothing we have measures multi-stream video models consistently, so we are scoping and staffing an internal evaluation harness built from scratch — Csilla at 45% owns it, first version by mid-May.

Compute: this is our heaviest ask this quarter. Multi-stream video training on the found architectures from model_structures.py needs 96 H100s, so we need a real Vulcan reservation, not best-effort — I've opened the request with Ines. Note Vulcan maintenance runs 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-24, so the final benchmark runs have to be complete before June 22 or they push past the readout.

The TF1 dependency is a genuine tax; Paloma is boxing it into a container so it doesn't leak into our TF2 stack.

Santiago
